title: Why we must advocate for proper care on the frontlines of the Ebola outbreak
title_zh: 为何我们必须倡导在埃博拉疫情前线提供适当护理
abstract: As the Bundibugyo virus public-health crisis continues to evolve, physician Richard Kojan is finding ways to care for people with the infection and helping relatives to visit loved ones safely.
abstract_zh: 随着邦迪布约病毒公共卫生危机的持续发展，医生理查德·科贾（Richard Kojan）正在寻找为感染者提供护理的方法，并帮助亲属安全探访亲人。
snippet: As the Bundibugyo virus public-health crisis continues to evolve, physician Richard Kojan is finding ways to care for people with the infection and helping relatives to visit loved ones safely.
